rv.q: Under Jen Wineman’s polished direction and choreography, the six-member, high-powered cast is always entertaining both singing and dancing, and while the jokes are often groaners, the show remains pleasant and cheerful if not original or fresh.
That Parenting Musical consistently aims for the lowest common denominator; its gags are often only marginally better than the 'Dad jokes' it repeatedly parodies.
It is two hours of rib-tickling fun.
